sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
Prof. Ganesh E. Kondhalkar President, Alumni Association 9822676607 ganeshkondhalkar@abmspcoerpune.org linkedin.com/in/ganesh-kondhalkar-67622353
On behalf of the Alumni Association’s Committee members as President of the Alumni Association, I welcome you to our online community! The association exists, wholly and solely, to help our alumni. One of our goals is to preserve a healthy relationship among alumna and with the institute. Alumni Association can help you to stay connected to friends, the faculties that taught and guided you to our libraries, seminars and symposia, web sites, social media. The association is designed to support you as you pursue your post-academic life and career. The executive committee members and I encourage you to share and use this platform as one way to engage with the Alumni Association and maintain your personal connection to the institute.
